title: HealME
description: This Mod Adds A /heal Command To Minecraft Which Instantly Heals You And Also Fills Up Your Hunger And Saturation
body: This Mod Is A Very Simple Mod, It Adds The Ability To Type /heal In A Singleplayer World (Multiplayer Not Tested), This Will Heal You Immediately, As A Bonus, It Will Also Fill Your Hunger Back Up And The Same With Your Saturation.
